name: Take 5: 30th Anniversary Edition

rounds.endCondition: Play rounds until a player reaches 66 or more bullheads (or an agreed target/number of rounds)

endCondition.description: Game ends at the end of the round in which any player reaches 66+ bullheads; fewest total wins

categories.label: Bullheads taken this round
categories.labelVi: Số đầu bò nhận trong ván
categories.hint: Count bullheads on cards in your bull pile; enter each round (1 per card; ends in 5 = 2; multiples of 10 = 3; doubles = 5; 55 = 7)

notes: family: penalty-points (lowest wins). Verified against the base Amigo 6 nimmt!/Take 5 rulebook; the 30th Anniversary edition rulebook itself was not obtained, so edition-specific changes (if any) are unverified. Pro variant for 2-6 players uses 10N+4 cards but scoring is unchanged.
